- [ ] Make Dvorak an unlockable layout — the last no-asset Phase 3 gameplay
  piece; steammvproadmap.md:113 states plainly "The unlockable cosmetic board
  themes/layouts are NOT built — Dvorak is a plain settings option", and
  states/settingsState.lua:22 (`local LAYOUTS = { "qwerty", "dvorak" }`)
  still offers both layouts freely through the select row at
  settingsState.lua:106-108 (`gameplay.layout`, default "qwerty" per
  engine/configManager.lua:46). Re-verified 2026-08-31: zero "unlock"
  matches in settingsState.lua and zero "dvorak" matches outside
  config/settings/keyboard-layout data. Spec: (1) add a persistent
  `unlocks` table to `PlayerModel` (serialized and restored with the rest of
  the save — follow the round-trip pattern tests/test_player_save.lua
  already exercises; corrupt/legacy saves must default it to `{}`); (2) set
  `unlocks.dvorak = true` on the run-victory branch — the same branch that
  fires `Steam.unlockAchievement("VICTORY_RUN")` at modules/game/run.lua:130
  — so "win a run" is the unlock condition; (3) gate the settings row:
  a locked layout is shown disabled (e.g. "Dvorak (win a run to unlock)")
  and `set()` refuses it, with a grandfather clause — if the player's config
  already has `gameplay.layout == "dvorak"`, treat it as unlocked so no
  existing player is stranded on a layout the UI won't select; (4) tests
  drive the real pipeline: fresh player cannot select dvorak, post-victory
  player can, grandfathered config stays valid, and the unlock survives a
  save/load round trip. `tests/run.lua` auto-discovers `test_<name>.lua`
  (run.lua:75).

## Needs a human decision

- Queue restocked to `max_items: 2`. Three valid candidates recorded here,
  not proposed, to respect the cap — full context below so nothing depends
  on git history; say the word and any will be specified next refresh:
  (a) harden the two weak starfield determinism tests —
  tests/test_background.lua:11 (same_seed_reproduces_identical_star_coordinates)
  never disturbs the global RNG between the two `Background.generate(8675309)`
  calls, so it cannot prove the module's Park-Miller PRNG is independent of
  `math.random`, and :20 (different_seeds_produce_different_star_fields)
  asserts only that the FIRST star differs between seeds 101/202 — both were
  cross-review #536's non-blocking notes; the fix is to call
  `math.randomseed`/`math.random` between the paired generates and to assert
  a whole-field difference (e.g. deepEqual must fail, or count differing
  stars > 1);
  (b) a test guarding `tools/build.sh`'s seven required directories
  (build.sh:21: engine, modules, states, lib, data, resources, tests)
  against silently emptying — the script only checks `exists()`, and three
  of the seven survive a clean checkout on the strength of a single tracked
  file (lib: serpent.lua only; data: words.txt only; resources:
  sounds/README.md only — per the #560 ledger note), so a stray deletion
  ships a hollow .love that still says BUILD OK;
  (c) README drift — README.md:131-134 documents `resources/sprites/` and

  only sounds/), :138 lists only get-love.ps1 and build.ps1 under tools/
